question: John Williams has more Oscar nominations than any living person, over fifty. How many has he won?
answer: Five: Fiddler on the Roof, for adapting its score, then Jaws, Star Wars, E.T. and Schindler's List. His nominations, 54 by 2024, are second only to Walt Disney's, yet in most of those years someone else won. His last win came at the ceremony of March 1994, more than thirty years ago.
move: A long list of entries tells little about the number of wins.
trap: Anchoring on 50-plus nominations and assuming a good share became wins.
source: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, 2024
reference: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, nominations for the 96th Academy Awards, 2024
